row.name: managed_mcp_connections_state_shape_check
row.value:
("state" = 'disconnected' and "active_grant_id" is null and "candidate_grant_id" is null and "connected_by_user_id" is null)
        or ("state" = 'connecting' and "active_grant_id" is null and "candidate_grant_id" is null and "connected_by_user_id" is null and "reason_code" is null)
        or ("state" = 'awaiting_confirmation' and "active_grant_id" is null and "candidate_grant_id" is not null and "connected_by_user_id" is null and "reason_code" is null)
        or ("state" = 'ready' and "active_grant_id" is not null and "candidate_grant_id" is null and "connected_by_user_id" is not null and "reason_code" is null)
        or ("state" = 'ready_with_pending_reconnect' and "active_grant_id" is not null and "candidate_grant_id" is not null and "connected_by_user_id" is not null and "reason_code" is null)
        or ("state" = 'reconnect_required' and "active_grant_id" is not null and "connected_by_user_id" is not null and "reason_code" is not null)

row.name: managed_oauth_attempts_verifier_shape_check
row.value:
("status" in ('pending', 'exchanging') and num_nonnulls("pkce_verifier_ciphertext", "pkce_verifier_iv", "pkce_verifier_auth_tag", "pkce_verifier_key_version") = 4)
        or ("status" not in ('pending', 'exchanging') and num_nonnulls("pkce_verifier_ciphertext", "pkce_verifier_iv", "pkce_verifier_auth_tag", "pkce_verifier_key_version") = 0)

row.name: managed_oauth_grants_refresh_claim_shape_check
row.value:
num_nonnulls("refresh_claim_id", "refresh_claimed_at") in (0, 2)
        and ("retired_at" is null or "refresh_claim_id" is null)

row.name: managed_oauth_grants_credentials_shape_check
row.value:
("retired_at" is null and num_nonnulls("credentials_ciphertext", "credentials_iv", "credentials_auth_tag", "credentials_key_version") = 4)
        or ("retired_at" is not null and num_nonnulls("credentials_ciphertext", "credentials_iv", "credentials_auth_tag", "credentials_key_version") = 0)

set.value: ("kind" = 'agent' AND "prompt" IS NOT NULL AND "entrypoint_json" IS NULL) OR ("kind" = 'code' AND "entrypoint_json" IS NOT NULL AND "prompt" IS NULL)

("state" = 'closed' and "close_reason" is not null and "closed_at" is not null) or ("state" = 'open' and "close_reason" is null and "resolution" is null and "closed_at" is null and "closed_by_user_id" is null and "closed_by_task_id" is null)
"work_item_id" IS NOT NULL OR "conversation_id" IS NOT NULL
